Visitors post comments, reply in threads, vote, and get email notifications on follow-up replies.

You moderate from a hosted admin panel, require email for spam control, pick from multiple skins, and paste one line of embed code on 200+ platforms including Google Sites, Canva, Elementor, Neocities, and Framer.

## Why Add a Comments Section to Your Website?

 ### Add comments to sites that do not have them

  Google Sites, Neocities, Carrd, Framer, and most AI-builder platforms (Lovable, Bolt, Replit) ship without a native comment section. Embedding a hosted widget is the only way to add real threaded discussion to those hosts without rebuilding the site on WordPress.
 ### Power a real blog comments section with replies and voting [...] Add Comments to Canva→

1. 1In Elementor, drag an HTML widget onto the page where you want the comment section.
2. 2Paste the Common Ninja embed snippet into the HTML widget's HTML code field.
3. 3Update the page. Comments render below the post and stay in sync with the moderation dashboard.

Add Comments to Elementor→

1. 1In your Neocities site editor, open the HTML page where you want the comment section.
2. 2Paste the Common Ninja embed snippet at the point in the markup where comments should render.
3. 3Save the file. Comments are live on your Neocities page, perfect for a retro guestbook or blog discussion.
